items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He said, who was in the Kid Albert and Barnes band? Well, Kid Albert, Barnes, Donna Handler.

ctx.x: I'm asking who was in the Kid Albert and Barnes band.

He said, who was in the Kid Albert and Barnes band? Well, Kid Albert, Barnes, Donna Handler. And the first part of Sean, they paid drum. Yeah, he lost his mind. He's in the K-Dow too. Then we got Joe Struttis and myself. Then we had Ory Foster. Ory Foster come up to the Muslim white people and had a step on a drum. And like two times, we had to get to play the Ory. And, uh, and R.C. Parisey. We had, um, we had six men.
Maybe Punch can answer. Ask him who was his favorite clarinet player, Baier.

He said, who was your favorite clarinet player, Baier? Who was the favorite? Your famous clarinet player, Baier. Baier? Yeah. Uh, I think it was Redline. Who was that? Donna Handler. If you can leave now, Donna Handler.
Ask him who had the black devils and black ones.
